papers.title: Energy-constrained two-way capacity bounds for noisy Gaussian channels
papers.abstract: A gap between achievable rates and converse bounds persists for energy-constrained bosonic communication in the presence of excess noise. We derive a unified adaptive weak-converse bound for thermal attenuation, noisy amplification, and additive Gaussian noise under an unconditional mean transmitted-photon-number constraint. papers.title: Normalised Hamiltonian Elliptic Systems: a Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality for bilinear mass
papers.abstract: We study Hamiltonian elliptic systems with prescribed bilinear mass $\int_{\mathbb{R}^N}uv=a>0$. We establish a Gagliardo--Nirenberg inequality in the crossed gradient pairing and bilinear mass, on scaling-invariant component-bounded classes. It identifies the critical curve $1/p+1/q=N/(N+2)$ and the restricted energy trichotomy. papers.title: Quantum twisting microscopy as a momentum-resolved probe of quantum geometry and sublattice symmetries
papers.abstract: In two-dimensional (2D) flat-band systems, as engineered, for instance, by stacking and twisting van der Waals materials, the momentum dependence of the Bloch states is a key factor in determining the interaction-induced emergence of different phases.
